Definition: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed
BiblicalUsage: 1) to stretch oneself out, lie down, lie stretched out; 1a) (Qal) to lie down, lie; 1b)(Hiphil) to cause to lie down; 1b1) laying (stones)
